_note: RE-CALIBRATED 2026-07-02 from captures/ (ONNX encoder, 14 images / 7 hands incl. friend2+friend3, left+right). Genuine same-hand cosine 0.607-0.865 (mean 0.717); impostor different-hand 0.265-0.647 (mean 0.456); EER 1.9% at thr~0.591. NOTE: the wider, more diverse impostor set raised the impostor MAX from 0.591 (10-image run) to 0.647, so the old clean gap is gone — there is now mild overlap at the genuine floor (0.607). 0.60 is kept as the balanced choice: it accepts every observed genuine (all >=0.607, 0% false-reject) and rejects the large majority of impostors, but a few impostor pairs now land in [0.60, 0.647]. Threshold @ FAR<=1% would be 0.647 but that rejects ~23% of genuine (bad UX). Levers to raise real accuracy beyond a single threshold: 3-sample enrolment (already on), quality gating at capture, and face+palm 'and' policy for high-assurance. Re-run palm.training.calibrate_from_images as more captures land.
